from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def task_func(df1, df2, column1="feature1", column2="feature2"):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    left = df1.copy()
    right = df2.copy()

    if column1 not in left.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"'{column1}' not found in df1")
    if column2 not in right.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"'{column2}' not found in df2")

    x_name = "__task_x__"
    y_name = "__task_y__"
    left = left.rename(columns={column1: x_name})
    right = right.rename(columns={column2: y_name})

    common_keys = [c for c in df1.columns if c in df2.columns and c not in {column1, column2}]
    if common_keys:
        merged = pd.merge(left, right, on=common_keys, how="inner")
    else:
        left_candidates = [c for c in df1.columns if c != column1]
        right_candidates = [c for c in df2.columns if c != column2]

        left_key = next((c for c in left_candidates if "id" in str(c).lower()), left_candidates[0] if left_candidates else None)
        right_key = next((c for c in right_candidates if "id" in str(c).lower()), right_candidates[0] if right_candidates else None)

        if left_key is not None and right_key is not None:
            merged = pd.merge(left, right, left_on=left_key, right_on=right_key, how="inner")
        else:
            merged = pd.concat([left.reset_index(drop=True), right.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)

    X = merged[[x_name, y_name]].to_numpy()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if X.shape[0] >= 2:
        labels = KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit_predict(X).astype(np.int32, copy=False)
        ax.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=labels, cmap="viridis")
    else:
        labels = np.zeros(X.shape[0], dtype=np.int32)
        if X.shape[0] == 1:
            ax.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=labels, cmap="viridis")

    ax.set_xlabel(column1)
    ax.set_ylabel(column2)

    return labels, ax
